slideDifferences.nativeText:
Conditionals link two different clauses as we learned in the last unit. First conditional links an action or circumstance in the present with another one in the future.
DEFINITIONS & POSSIBLE CASE
INDEPENDENT CLAUSE
DEPENDENT CLAUSE
1
They can exist alone.
You’ll get a sunburn...
IF you get too much sun.
2
They need another clause to exist.
He will need a MRI...
IF he hits his head.
3
Switching Clauses
If she cuts while cooking ,
She’ll probably need stitches.
To Consider

The use of will is necessary since it is the way consequences in the future are expressed.
Sometimes, ‘can’ is also used to state a consequence. E.G: If you get wet under the rain, you can get a cold.
When the IF clause is the first one, it needs to be separated by a comma (,) from the other clause.

To Consider 1. The use of will is necessary since it is the way consequences in the future are expressed. 2. Sometimes, ‘can’ is also used to state a consequence. E.G: If you get wet under the rain, you can get a cold. 3. When the IF clause is the first one, it needs to be separated by a comma (,) from the other clause.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
We can use the first conditional aiming the following functions or aspects
Functions
Examples
1
Talking about illness and conditions people can get.
I will have to see a doctor if the fever continues.
If they do not operate him, he will lose his leg.
2
Warning people.
If Shane does not pass the course, he will be grounded for months.
The boys will not go to the party if they do not clean their room.
To consider 
This two areas are not the only ones that can be covered. Generally, talking about consequences may be include the use of the conditional.

E.G: Should he fail, we will lose the game.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
Bullying

How many people do you know that face bullying? Bullying has become more popular these days; many students face it at school and now even in their own social media. If this is not controlled, we will get youngsters with repressed anger or depression or even suicidal tendencies. We will be facing this for a long time if we don’t do anything about it; If parents do not start working values from their homes, they will see their own children become the bullies or the bullied ones. If we want to see some change, we need to start making a difference now.
